title: Command: check
lead:
`dlog check QUERY` searches titles, keys, tags and decision text and reports
decided / open / not found.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 6; v1 feature tier; Milestone 3

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 6: an agent asks "has X been decided?" before it asks the owner.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A query matching a decided record reports `decided` with its ID.
- A query matching only open records reports `open`.
- No match reports `not found`.
- Matching covers titles, keys, tags and decision text.
- `check --json` has a stable, documented shape.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement the search in `query`. Gap: PROJECT.md does not define the match rule
(substring, case, word) or the exit code per result; propose one in review.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
